rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a professional or academic researcher.

example.english: That researcher specializes in marine research.
example.traditional: 嗰位研究員專門做海洋研究。
example.jyutping: go2 wai2 jin4 gau3 jyun4 zyun1 mun4 zou6 hoi2 joeng4 jin4 gau3

rows.note: A speaker chooses this more formal term when emphasizing the person who conducts research rather than their job title.

example.english: A researcher cannot just look at the results; they must also explain the research methods.
example.traditional: 研究者唔可以只睇結果，仲要交代研究方法。
